name: TCL 65C7L
summary: TCL 65C7L Google TV (Australia, 2025) ships with TCL tracking, ads and promos. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This 65-inch TCL C7L, sold in Australia in 2025, runs Google TV 14. It ships with TCL tracking and analytics, TCL content, ads and promos, a retail demo and hotel mode, and preloaded apps and services. Three more apps are off by choice.

It was tested on a real unit in six batches with screenshots between them. All four HDMI inputs, Live TV, YouTube and every remote button kept working, and all 27 apps stayed off after a restart. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: Live TV and the HDMI inputs
Google Assistant and the mic button
Netflix, Prime Video, YouTube and YouTube Music
notes: The setup wizard owned the saved Wi-Fi network on this set. Forget it and rejoin in Settings first, or the TV drops off Wi-Fi.
Switching off the setup wizard is only safe after the new home screen is set, or a blank screen can take Home.

faq.a: Yes. Chromecast, AirPlay and Miracast are all kept by the owner.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work?
faq.a: Yes. Google Assistant and the remote service that carries the mic button are kept.

faq.q: Does it have a way back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on in one tap, and puts the old home screen back if you changed it.
